title: TRACE is accepted to ACCV 2026
text: Our paper "TRACE: Time-Adaptive Residual Attention Control with Content-Style Decomposition for Training-Free Diffusion Style Transfer" has been accepted to ACCV 2026.

title: Pixelchemy Research website launched
text: Pixelchemy Research is now online, bringing together our research projects, publications, people, and research updates.

title: AttNetVLAD is accepted to RIVF 2025
text: Our work "AttNetVLAD and AttNetVLAD++: Capturing Frame Feature Correlations with Self-Attention for Event Spotting in Football Videos" was accepted to RIVF 2025.

title: LTDAD-Talker is accepted to ICCCI 2025
text: Our work "LTDAD-Talker: Landmark-Guided Talking Face Generation with Temporal Consistency and Detail-Aware Discriminator" was accepted to ICCCI 2025.
